name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a pad holding the ab wheel with both hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis so your back is neutral.
Roll the wheel forward as far as you can control, body staying straight.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees using your abs, not your hips.
tip: If your lower back arches or you collapse at the bottom, you're past your controlled range. Shorten the rollout until the brace holds, then extend over time.
